family_contract.entry_rule: At each completed close, rank all four ETFs by the frozen trailing return, require the leader's return to clear the cross-sectional median and five-times-cost floor, then enter at the next open.

execution_assumptions.shared_signal_contention: the 20-bps path freezes the conservative filled-signal set used unchanged by all cost scenarios

family_contract.exit_rule: Resolve stop first on daily ambiguity and otherwise exit at the completed close after three or five sessions.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Long only, next-session-open entry, and flat within five sessions.
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This exact version retains the existing cross-sectional-momentum mechanism but replaces concentrated microcap equity exposure with a complete four-index-ETF universe and prospectively frozen risk, trend, lookback, cost, and hold rules.
family_contract.mechanism: Rank the complete liquid index-ETF universe by trailing return and buy the strongest cost-clearing leader only while SPY remains in a completed long-term uptrend.

predecessor.adverse_finding: primary drawdown exceeded the Stage 0 maximum

family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological account log growth after costs.
production_compatibility_risks: Live quote, spread, depth, halt, tradability, timestamp, protection, and reconciliation gates remain required.
family_contract.ranking_rule: Highest completed trailing return, then lexical symbol; at most one new family entry per session.
family_contract.selection_rule: Portfolio risk, concurrent-position, aggregate-risk, daily-entry, gross-notional, and capital-contention caps remain authoritative.
family_contract.stop_rule: Place the exact 1.5 or 2.0 ATR14 structural stop below entry; invalid or missing stops produce missed trades.
